about: The crypt's 192 px bridge (docs/milestones/connected-biomes.md, CB8): the crypt bridge (crypt_bridge.shape.json) at another length, so the generator lines rooms up at more spans and closes loops. A stand-in until the bridges' own art (CB12). tools/ground_shape.py draws crypt_bridge_192_ground.tscn and its art from this.
